import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem Shakarchi_exercise_1_19b_unique (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, z ^ (i + 1) / (i + 1) ^ 2)) :
    ∃! y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  classical
  set f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => z ^ (n + 1) / (n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2 with hfdef
  have h_norm :
      (fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖) =
        (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    funext n
    have hzpow : ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ = 1 := by
      simp [hz, Complex.norm_pow z (n + 1)]
    have hdenpow :
        ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hden : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ)‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
          (Complex.norm_natCast (n + 1))
      simp [pow_two, hden]
    calc
      ‖f n‖ = ‖z ^ (n + 1)‖ / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by
        simp [f]
      _ = 1 / ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 2‖ := by simp [hzpow]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by simp [hdenpow]
  have h_pSeries :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have h_base :
        Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).mpr one_lt_two
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 h_base
  have h_norm_summable : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖f n‖) := by
    rw [h_norm]
    exact h_pSeries
  have hfSummable : Summable f := Summable.of_norm h_norm_summable
  refine ⟨∑' n, f n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hy : HasSum f (∑' n, f n) := hfSummable.hasSum
    simpa [h, f] using hy.tendsto_sum_nat
  · intro y hy
    have hlim : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, f n)) := by
      have hsum : HasSum f (∑' n, f n) := hfSummable.hasSum
      simpa [h, f] using hsum.tendsto_sum_nat
    exact (tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hy).symm
